[Thinking]
**Interpreting solar eclipse date**

I need to figure out the last solar eclipse before the year 2000, so I'm looking for something that happened before January 1, 2000. In 1999, there were notable eclipses: an annular eclipse on February 16 and a total eclipse on August 11. The last one before 2000 was August 11, 1999. It seems logical to confirm that, since eclipses generally happen every six months, the next one would be on February 5, 2000. So, I’ll go with that date.
[/Thinking]

The last solar eclipse before the year 2000 occurred on **August 11, 1999**.

It was a **total solar eclipse**, visible across parts of Europe, the Middle East, and Asia.
